1. “I met Vaior, and he felt different, something quite mortal about him.”
    
2. “Perhaps it was not the power, that was celestial no doubt, it was the anger.”
    
3. “His hatred for creation, for Shao Daraan was not alien to me, it was honest, it was mortal.”
    
4. “I decided to search time for answers, to ease my worry before returning to the throne.”
    
5. “I looked beyond where I should have, and what I saw blinded me, but it opened my eyes.”
    
6. “I don’t know where he came from, but I know he is dangerous, he cannot do it alone.”
    
7. “He seeks to end everything, his replicants cannot do it for him.”
    
8. “He will summon himself every time, break down the barriers, an army who understands his pain.”
    
9. “Atomic Gods, he kept saying Atomic Gods, I fear not the creator, but the destroyer.”
    
10. “He said the most important piece was his locket. He doesn’t wear a necklace…”
    
11. “I see a red gemstone from the chained one, power, prices, the Time God, who can stop revenge against creation itself?”
    
12. “All times, all possibilities, he only dies when Daraan watches…”
